name: adapter_bring_up

ownership.argument: The adapter instance global 0x2013DBE4 is only ever a pointer: its value is set here from bt_adapter_create, so the instance itself is a 212-byte heap object and the .data at 0x2013DBE4 is just the pointer slot (the image bytes there are 0xFF filler, i.e. not a ROM initialiser).

provenance.source: Creates the adapter instance with bt_adapter_create 0xC3AF1A8 (212-byte object initialised as 'bluetooth'), configures it with 0xC3AF26C, registers the callback table &off_2CDB9504 through bt_adapter_register 0xC3AF3E8, reads the state with bt_adapter_get_state 0xC3AF4F4, logs the transition when it reaches 4, registers 0xCAA5048(&off_2CDC3088, 0xCA40DE4, 0) and stores the state byte.

notes: The adapter instance global 0x2013DBE4 is only ever a pointer: its value is set here from bt_adapter_create, so the instance itself is a 212-byte heap object and the .data at 0x2013DBE4 is just the pointer slot (the image bytes there are 0xFF filler, i.e. not a ROM initialiser).
